public_capability_audit.publication_state: internal-experimental opt-in cross-project; excluded from the default reframe4s bundles
public_capability_audit.execution_surface: PE and small-strain models, optimizers, matrix-free operators and workspaces remain private[flashalign]; this qualification does not promote them to a stable external execution API
public_capability_audit.public_surface: Versioned immutable nonlinear model, field, domain, acquisition, certificate, inverse-evidence and result records plus strict restoration and named affine-component export
public_capability_audit.mutable_alias: No public nonlinear record contains Array or another mutable buffer. The two Array fields in NonlinearResult.scala are private scratch arrays inside the private GeometrySpatialMap3 adapter and never escape.
public_capability_audit.owner_safety: No asInstanceOf or unchecked annotation occurs in the nonlinear implementation files. Point mapping validates the source owner and uses Frame.alignOwners before returning a target point.
public_capability_audit.inverse_capability: The numerical inverse is exposed only as SpatialMap with retained inverse evidence. Tests require the evidence to say numerical inverse and not SmoothIso; no SmoothIso or exact inverse capability is fabricated.
public_capability_audit.matrix_export: Complete nonlinear matrix export is rejected; only the separately named GlobalPoseComponentOnly record is available.
public_capability_audit.platform_types: No java.io, java.nio, Thread, Executor or Future type occurs in shared nonlinear implementation files. Filesystem and NIfTI concerns remain in the JVM-only evidence runner.
public_capability_audit.workspace_and_failure_contracts: Wrong model, basis, owner, shape, stale sample identity, workspace reuse/reentry, inverse domain, inverse exhaustion, certificate and output failures are typed and tested before unsafe computation or padding.
